Question: Is Admiral Ackbar really better than Thrawn? What are each one's strengths and weaknesses?
Answer: Yes, in Legends Ackbar is the superior admiral. This is demonstrated by each admiral’s strengths and weaknesses. Thrawn’s greatest weakness was when third-party or irregular forces would disrput his carefully laid plans. During the battle of Sluis Van, Lando Calrissian’s mole miners delivered one of Thrawn’s first defeats. At Bilbringi, he was assassinated by his bodyguard Rukh. Ackbar’s only weakness, however, was how good he was. The Essential Guide to Warfare notes “If Ackbar had a weakness, it was that he was irreplaceable.” (pg. 182) Now, Ackbar’s greatest strength was his ability to work with others. Ackbar was the father of the Alliance fleet, and he wielded it as if it was an extension of his own body. Ackbar united the various rebel leaders in 1 BBY and would combine small rebel cells into the Alliance fleet. In addition, Ackbar commanded great respect among his soldiers, and his return to the New Republic in 27 ABY during the Yuuzhan Vong War sparked widespread celebration on New Republic vessels. A large part of this was due to Ackbar’s willingness to work and understand his subordinates at a level that truly mattered. In the Young Jedi Knights: The Lost Ones, we see Ackbar piloting a transport to get a better understanding of how the New Republic navy functioned at its most basic level. This also helped command respect among his subordinates. Thrawn’s greatest strength was his ability to exploit the weaknesses of others. At the Battle of Obroa-Skai, Thrawn was able to exploit the fact that his opponent was an Elom to win the battle. This ability is certainly quite powerful and effective. However, it’s also something Ackbar does much better. In Legacy of the Force: Tempest, Admiral Nek Bwua’tu states that only Ackbar could exploit his enemy’s weakness so masterfully- putting Ackbar directly above Thrawn in that category. In conclusion, yes, Ackbar is clearly much better than Thrawn. I’ll also link a doc fulling breaking down each of the admiral’s feats and quotes if you want a more expansive answer. Stay safe, -Ben

The Hutts are the Hutts, a massive criminal empire that controls a region of space in the Outer Rim. And the Hapes Consortium is a small but very powerful monarchy located in the Inner Rim. The leadup to Fondor begins after the Yuuzhan Vong take Gyndine. There, they make an alliance with the Hutts. The Vong will spare Hutt worlds if the Hutts allow the Vong to operate in Hutt Space. The Hutts agree, with the sole condition that the Vong tell the Hutts what planets they will attack so the Hutts can stop shipping spice to those planets, so the Hutts don’t lose any planets. The Vong tell the Hutts that they will attack Tynna, Corellia, and Bothuwai. The Hutts immediately tell the New Republic. Meanwhile, the New Republic allies itself with the Hapes Consortium. The Hapes pledge their considerable wealth and fleet to the New Republic, and leave for Commenor. The Vong take Tynna, meeting little resistance. Question: Was Ahsoka Tano the first Jedi to use a white lightsaber?
Answer: No. In Legends, there are multiple examples of Jedi who used a white lightsaber. Most notably, Corran Horn used a white blade, which he constructed while under captivity on Courkrus. Corran’s blade was a dual phase lightsaber, as it could extend from 1.33 meters to 3 meters in length. This was a tactic Horn used to great effect, helping him defeat foes such as Mara Jade, Shedao Shai, and four Sith Sabers during the Liberation of Coruscant. In conclusion, no, Ahsoka was not the first Jedi to use a white lightsaber. Question: What is the scummiest job in Star Wars?
Answer: In Legends, Peace Brigade Refugee Workers. During the Yuuzhan Vong invasion in Star Wars, trillions of beings became refugees when their homeworlds were taken over by the Vong. This created a massive refugee crisis. As a result, many refugee camps became overcrowded and underfunded. Above: a refugee camp In order to escape these horrible conditions, many refugees would pay people to escort them off world. However, some of these people worked for the Peace Brigade, a group of Yuuzhan Vong collaborators. These people would get info from the Vong about where the Vong would strike next, and then take the refugees to that world. When the Vong would attack those planets, the former refugees would become refugees once again, and pay the people who transported them to move them elsewhere. The cycle would continue- all the while taxing the New Republic’s resources. Above: Refugees abord a passenger liner So, being a Peace Brigade Refugee Worker is the scummiest job in Star Wars. Stay safe, -Ben
